title: Video Orchestrator Production Package Draft (VO-2C)
description: Metadata-only package draft for scheduling and planning. VO-2C creates draft packages without rendering real media. ready_to_post remains false until real local media validation exists in VO-2D.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this package format.

package_id.description: Unique identifier for this package draft. Format: pkg-<job_id>

video_id.description: Optional. Reference to source video or episode if applicable.

project_id.description: Project identifier from project distribution plan.

account_id.description: Local symbolic reference to platform account (e.g., 'youtube-channel-main'). This is a safe label only, NOT a token, credential reference, keychain URL, or platform secret.

source_job_id.description: Scheduler job ID that produced this package draft.

package_state.description: Draft: metadata-only, awaiting media validation. Ready: all media present and validated (VO-2D+). Blocked: validation failed. Exported: uploaded or exported for manual posting.

dry_run.description: Always true for VO-2C. Production packages require explicit authorization.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when draft was created.

video.description: Optional. Path to video file (populated by VO-2D when rendering exists).

thumbnail.description: Optional. Path to thumbnail image (populated by VO-2D when generation exists).

captions.description: Paths to caption files if available. Empty in VO-2C drafts.

metadata.description: Safe metadata from source job. Never includes credentials, tokens, or secrets.

safe_zone_profile.description: Optional. Safe zone profile name for layout guidance.

ready_to_post.description: Always false for VO-2C. Must remain false until real local media validation exists.

blocking_reasons.description: Reasons preventing upload (e.g., 'Media rendering not implemented in VO-2C').

generated_by.description: Identifier of component that created this draft (e.g., 'VO-2C createProductionPackageDraft').

source_manifest_path.description: Optional. Path to source production manifest if applicable.
